title: Revenue Contribution Shift
scenario: Determine if a campaign's rank improved or worsened compared to the previous week.
tableSchema: perf (camp_id INT, week INT, rev NUMERIC)
hint: Calculate rank per week, then use LAG() to compare.
correctQuery: SELECT camp_id, week, (prev_rank - curr_rank) AS rank_change FROM (SELECT camp_id, week, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY week ORDER BY rev DESC) AS curr_rank, LAG(RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY week ORDER BY rev DESC)) OVER(PARTITION BY camp_id ORDER BY week) AS prev_rank FROM perf) t;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE perf (camp_id INT, week INT, rev NUMERIC);
